title: Incorrect dunder method check in ChainableUndefined
detail: The condition mistakenly raises AttributeError for names that are not dunder methods but end with double underscores, causing legitimate attribute accesses to fail and breaking protocol probing.
note: Describes the planted flip in the dunder check.

title: Incorrect cookie prefix validation logic
detail: The function returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-" because the condition `not name.startswith("__host-")` is False, causing all __Host- cookies to be rejected even if they satisfy the required conditions. Additionally, for non-__Host- cookies it incorrectly requires the path to be exactly "/" and no domain, rejecting valid cookies with other paths or domains.
note: Says every __Host- cookie is now rejected, which the planted `and` does.

title: Incorrect raw mode detection for short option -R
detail: The logic treats any short option containing the letter 'r' (case-insensitive) as disabling raw mode. For the short option "-R" (which requests raw control characters), token[1:] is "R", casefolded to "r", so the function incorrectly returns False, causing raw mode not to be enabled when the user passes "-R".
note: Describes the planted inversion: a short flag with `r` (like -R) isn't detected.
